title: Reduction to three-query PCPPs
statement: Suppose that for every positive input length and every Boolean circuit on that input length, a PCPP description is given for the property accepted by the circuit, and every such description has a positive query count. Applying the three-query transformation to each description defines a new reduction assigning a three-query PCPP description for the same circuit-accepted property.
hypotheses_covered: A semantic PCPP reduction for every positive input length and Boolean circuit
Every output description has positive query count
